185604.overview:
Evil is on the rise, and it's up to the World Heroes to save the day! World Heroes Supreme Justice Extra is a widescreen update to the Neo Geo arcade original from 1992. It was created by Magggas using the OpenBor engine in 2013 and officially completed five years later.

This remake features 11 fighters, including 6 new ones: Muscle, J. Max, Janne, Gokuu, Kisarah, and C. Kidd. Along with fast and fluid controls, each character can pull off serial combos and unique super moves. Beat 'em up and smash your way across the stages to find health, money and weapons, with a tough boss waiting at the end. With great gameplay and HD visuals, it's a perfect example of a classic made modern.

216733.overview:
Warslayers - Land of Sinners is a Beat´´ em up type hack´ n slash game like Knights of the Round or Dungeons and Dragons - Shadows over Mystara, it tells the typical story of 2 warriors who fight a great war in order to destroy Daegas, the black knight and his legion of beasts, thieves and demons, but ... do not be bored by this simple description, the game has a plot full of satire, dark humor (well, something) fourth wall break, little cameos of other video game characters and sexual references, this game is the direct sequel of my previous OpenBOR game: Guardians of the Requiem - The Warriors of God.

In the game you will be able to choose between 2 main characters, and you will have to fight in more than 10 different scenarios together with a squad of soldiers that will help you fight throughout the game. The game has several unlockable modes, A Boss Rush arena type, a defense mode, 2 AI modes and a small theater gallery, try to get the secret ending in Impossible Defense mode. (´-´)

453618.overview: Bush up on your Chinese and try out the cinematic offering from Volcanic. Warriors of Fate takes the Capcom classic and updates it with artistic cut-scenes, branching paths, new moves, new weapons and a touch of violence for a more visceral experience.
